rows.en: I don't like the look of this.
rows.notes: Transcript says "this feeling is good" (kono kanji, ii mono da) inside the retreat group 187-189; guessed a garbled "mazui/yabai" (not good), as clip 187 is also garbled.

rows.en: At this rate, we'll have to pull out.
As expected of you, Captain!
I can't let the Captain outdo me.
The Princess isn't half bad either.
Keep it up like this, Klan.
Paired up with you? What a sad state of affairs.
I'm passing on this op! ...Whoa, yeah, guess I can't.
Hey, whatever you do, don't screw up.
Don't do anything reckless.
Women and bullets, I hit with one shot. Leave it to me.
Don't get fired up over a mission this easy.
Don't fight alone. We're a team.
I've got your back. I'll give you perfect support.
I'll count on you, for what it's worth.
Let's wrap this up quick and take it easy today.
Trust my support, okay?
A team like ours has this in the bag, right?
That was a rough one.
Phew... Geez, you sloppy rookie.
Keep this up and you'll get yourself killed, or get someone else killed.
I'll clean up the next one with my sniping too.
Well, well, another day's work done. Good job.
Looks like I'll make it in time for my date.
That was a nice follow-up, wasn't it?
Did my sniping meet with your approval?
Results just as expected. Good work.
Work's done, so how about a guys' night out for once?
Glad I've got such a dependable partner.
Fighting next to you, I never feel like losing.
I'm not getting dragged down with you. Do it right.
Sortieing with you? Read the mood, would you.
At least be useful as a decoy.
Let's go! Loosen up those shoulders!
Well, shall we get started?
Don't get worked up! You'll ruin that beautiful face!
Make it back alive and I'll treat you to a joyride with me.
When I heard a beauty like you was in trouble, I couldn't leave you be.
I'll back you up from the rear. Leave it to me.
rows.notes: Heard "koushi tomo ni" (nonsense); guessed "kouhou kara" (from the rear) / support.

rows.en: I'll protect you, no matter what.
With my sniping, no one will lay a finger on you.
You can count on me anytime.
Better than an amateur, at least.
Not bad, for you.
You didn't get in my way. That's good enough.
Quite the skill. Wow, I clearly underestimated you.
Well, all's well that ends well.
At this rate, maybe you didn't need my support?
Now then, shall we hit the town and go into overtime?
My support was useful, wasn't it?
Well, we're all going home together, so let's call it good.
I'll protect you as many times as it takes.
I'm counting on you too.
Even if reaction weapons rain down, we won't lose, right?
Captain, it's Gilliam's team!
rows.notes: Transcript is fragmentary ("taichou, Gilliam-tai"); read as an announcement to the leader.

rows.en: Really an amateur? Pretty good skill for one.
Geez, you sloppy fool.
On it!
rows.notes: Transcript "taisho!" (0.5 s); likely a short acknowledgement, guessed.

rows.en: I'll do it!
No comment.
Tch, I've got a guy for an opponent?
Shoot me down and get a free joyride with me.
I'm ready to go anytime.
Shut up, Klan! Stop going on about when we were kids!
Alto! That ship's like a porcupine!
Take this!
Klan? That meddler.
Right, you're stepping neatly into my line of fire.
rows.notes: Transcript has the kanji for traffic lane (shasen); read as the homophone shasen, line of fire, for a sniper.

rows.en: Good thing you didn't run.
Hey.
I still don't get it. What were you thinking, sis, when you pulled that trigger?
But maybe someday I will. Right, sis?
Alto! Special delivery, your birthday present!
Ranka's there too?
What a woman. I could fall for her.
No way!?
Ranka's song is changing how the Vajra behave.
They say lots of the brass are Minmay Attack believers, but playing songs for the Vajra? Seriously?
rows.notes: Transcript has odd kanji for Minmay Attack (minmei attack) and a garbled word for the brass (oeraigata); read as Minmay Attack and the military brass.

rows.en: Seriously?
Falling for someone for real means putting your life on the line.
